sections.heading: Opening (5 minutes)
sections.rationale: The legacy hook compares 2.75 and 3 Liberian dollars. Kept the idea of a familiar comparison but moved it to scale readings (1.5 kg against 1.25 kg), which also sets up the longer-is-larger misconception.

sections.heading: Direct Instruction (15 minutes)
sections.rationale: The chart idea is reused, but Example 1 is wrong: it says the 5 in 15.258 is in the tenths place (0.5). The 5s are worth 5 and 0.05. The worked example now uses 15.258 and corrects this. Reviewer to confirm.

sections.heading: Guided Practice (15 minutes)
sections.rationale: The legacy zero item (3.045) is correct and kept as the zero-placeholder idea, rebuilt as items with misconception-specific feedback.

sections.heading: Independent Practice (8 minutes)
sections.rationale: Legacy items 12.783 and 2.009 are correct and reused; comparison items are added because the legacy lesson never practised its compare objective.

sections.heading: Answer Key:
sections.rationale: The answer key was shown to learners. Keys now live only in the reviewer-only assessment definitions.

sections.heading: Closing (7 minutes)
sections.rationale: The single exit question (value of 5 in 7.52) is replaced by an exit ticket covering both objectives; the closing becomes a reflection with a stated 7-day retrieval.
